thread:
mika-sec: FYI found a partner CI job that pulled KMS-wrapped ciphertext for secrets under secret/data/onboard/partnerX. Looks like ciphertext + a short-lived SA token leaked in a partner CI log. No KMS key material exposed, but we should contain and rotate affected artifacts.

jasper-infra: can you list object ids / paths?

mika-sec: paths: secret/data/onboard/partnerX/*; artifact names: obj-2023-11-01-enc-01, obj-2023-11-02-enc-02. partner SA: svc-partnerx@partner.iam.gserviceaccount.com

nina-sre: immediate steps: revoke any dynamic leases on that path and disable audit gaps. `vault lease revoke -prefix=secret/data/onboard/partnerX/` I'll take leases.

leo-devex: suggest envelope-wrap approach instead of KEK rotate to reduce customer impact: create transient transit key `incident-wrap-1725009999`, encrypt the existing ciphertext blobs as plaintext under transit, and restrict decrypt to a single rewrap runner token.

mika-sec: agree. also blacklist the partner SA at org level and disable any long-lived keys.

jasper-infra: creating transit key now: `vault write -f transit/keys/incident-wrap-1725009999` will create key with no export. Making a k8s job for rewrap runner with TTL 1h token.

nina-sre: leases revoked=4. posting output to #eng-oncall.

vault-bot: audit_check: vault-audit active on cluster=redwood-prod true. New audit file: /var/log/vault/audit-1725009999.log

leo-devex: rewrap runner pseudocode (we'll embargo creds in runbook):
```
for blob in BLOB_LIST; do
  download blob -> /tmp/blob.bin
  b64=$(base64 /tmp/blob.bin | tr -d '\n')
  vault write transit/encrypt/incident-wrap-1725009999 plaintext=$b64
  store returned ciphertext as blob.incident1725009999
done
```

jasper-infra: created runner `rewrap-1725009999` in namespace infra-incidents. token posted to private runbook. Starting rewrap for 6 blobs.

ops-bot: incident_job(1725009999) started: revoke_leases=true create_transit=true rewrap_runner=allocated

mika-sec: after rewrap, schedule rotation of any long-lived partner keys and run a log sweep for accidental plaintext prints. use `scripts/cred_sweep.sh --pattern=partnerX`

nina-sre: rewrap complete: rewraps=6; manifest uploaded to gs://redwood-incident/1725009999/manifest.json (includes checksums).

jasper-infra: blacklist applied: org deny for svc-partnerx@partner.iam.gserviceaccount.com. disabled 3 SA keys and revoked 1 AWS key.

mika-sec: enabling immediate Splunk forward for the new audit file and tagging events with incident:1725009999.

ops-bot: incident_job update: leases_revoked=4 rewraps_completed=6 sa_keys_disabled=3 blacklist_applied=true audit_forwarding_enabled=true

leo-devex: next steps: (1) short postmortem and notify partner/legal (2) add CI PR check to block pushing logs that contain `gs://` or `s3://` artifacts to public CI (3) tighten onboarding role to avoid `storage.objectAdmin` in infra modules.

mika-sec: assigning APs: jasper owns blacklist + runner creds, nina owns forensics + logs, leo owns devex checklist and CI check. Update this thread when PRs/JIRA tasks created.

ops-bot: incident_job complete: followups created SEC-621, INFRA-1401, DEVEX-317

mika-sec: thanks team. small reminder: envelope-wrap is reversible only if we keep the transit key; we'll schedule secure destruction of the transient key after investigation and confirmed no further access. :thumbsup:
